book.name: 1 Korinti
book.title: KORINTI KINA'MI NKISA PORO KAENTIYE (KA YAGANE)

content: Poroba maripo yawama kamana uma aborantiye
Nao'mitaba, naeba tigeti irosa'ma Koti nkage awaga kamana urimintopa, aogi napiyenanetasabe tabe kamana'netasabe kampa aborarimintone.
Naeba to ka'isa kamanapa kampa uma, Isu Karaisiti nkago kamana'amana urimikena napintone. Piya, aeba yara purinti kamana urimintone.
We, pai tigege mintantopa, esegiyenanepa kampa waima tabera naekuru puma tabaraba puma mintantone.
Piya, monopa urimintopa, aogi napiyenayaga yagarama kamanapisaba kampa napiyenaripa a'wae puntone. Kampaye. Awamusa'ama nkesegiyenarasa aboraramintuwe.
Piya, a'yugu timatiti'enarimpa wasanama kamana'amati atakibewe. Koti nkesegiyenamanati ataiyoma, piya puntone.

We, Kotitisa aogi napiyenagaba taga sune. Eya, mono aogima abinta kina'miba pipa abintawe. Pipa mabisa napiyenaba kampa uma, mabisa kiye kina'mi ntapiyenaba kampa yune. Kampaye. Mampabisa kina'mi ntapiyenaba nagariwakiye.

Pigoya, taeba Koti kakanta kamana'ama nkagoba uma aboraune. Piya, pi e'wasa puratakena kamanapa Kotiba paitaka'ya, ma kampa aboranti ntagaba, napima wasanami nkiyobi kakantemine. Pipa ibaba uramega agowapa uma aboraune.
We, mampabisa kiye kina'miba pi kamana'ama nkagoba kampa abibebe puntawe. Abibebe puntasinta, e'wasa Wa'egaba maripo yarapa kampa aeguntasine.

content.text: Wasana aorasa kampa agama, agebisa kampa abima, antabaipinti kampa napiyemintanaba, pipa Kotiba aborama, ae agu kao'ena pota kina, ige'ena Koti maema ai'aru puwaitaye, iye.

content: Pigoya, pi kamana'ama nkagoba Kotiba otaogana Awamusa'ama uma aboraramintine. Eya, Awamusa'amaba a'ya'maenama nkagowapa abiwaemagina, Koti kakamarantapa kaga abintiye.
Piya, ka'waina ao'ma nkagutasa agowapa abikiya, a. Pipa kampaye. Agu'wama nkagowama aewa abikiye. Pabiyama wasana Koti nkagoba kampa uwaba abegina, Koti Nkawamusa'wampa abiwa abiye.
Piya, taeba mampabisa awamusapa kampa maeyune. Kampaye. Taeba Koti Nkawamusa maeyompepa, Koti a'muntana tamemika abiyomawe.

Eya, Koti aboraramintemintanama nkagoba kampa wasanami ntapiyenabisa aboraune. Kampaye. Pi nkagoba Awamusa'ama uramegi uma aboraune. Piya, Awamusa'ama taga kamanapa uwaimokini, Awamusa maeya kina'miba abewe.

Pigoya, Awamusa kampa wainta yagaramaba Koti Nkawamusa'ama nkaboraramintanaba kampa maekiye. Pipa kampaye. Aeba pika abekanaba: Aibo kamanane, umagina kampa aogima abikiye. Kampaye. Pipa Awamusa'amatasa agoba abokana, uwa kina'mi abikenaenaba kampaye.
Piya, Awamusa'wantaga yagarama a'ya'maenama nkagoba agama kanara a'yikikiye. Aibekana, Awamusa kampa wainta kina'miba pi ntagarama nkagoga aibosabo pikibewe.
We, mono isa'amaba maya iye: Wa'egawama ntapiyenaba kebaya a'ya'ma abima amato puma omikiye, iye. Pigoya, taeba Karaisiti ntapiyenaba maema miyune.
